@Kim Morrison This PR simplifying the main page and entry pages is now ready for review. The primary change is just to make sections collapsable, see the description for more.

There's more that can be done, the next pass is probably more of an aesthetic one (colours / smooth scroll / etc.) But I think this is a good first changeset.
